name: Toolbar
description:
A toolbar: `Root`, `Button` (with toggles), `Group`, `Item` (any control), `Separator`
and `Spacer`, plus Base UI's `Input` and `Link` for text fields and links in the row.
signature: ({ "aria-label": label, size, overflow, disabled, children, labels, className }: ToolbarProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the toolbar for assistive technology ("Formatting"). Required: toolbars are landmarks of controls.

props.name: children
props.description: Toolbar.Button, Toolbar.Group, Toolbar.Item, Toolbar.Separator and Toolbar.Spacer.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: overflow
props.description:
Fold items into a trailing More menu when they do not fit, by `priority` (default true).
Off, the toolbar never folds; give it room or let it scroll.

props.name: size
props.description: sm (default) for panel headers and editors, md beside fields.
